Manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="DB" /> '''Shadow Three''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]] affiliated with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Shadow wing]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="JKTCG2" /> Operated by the [[TIE pilot]] [[PS-29-3]],<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] had a command system capable of coordinating the combined power of the entire Shadow [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]],<ref name="JKTCG2" /> while its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] likewise had designs on being Shadow wing's leading pilot.<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=PS-29-3 • "Hammer"|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/62Ups293hammer.html}}</ref> At some point, Shadow Three flew through a trench.<ref name="JKTCG2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shadow Three was introduced in [[2001]]'s [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="JKTCG2" />
